title: Turbo Dismount first five — CONTAIN ports
note: Secret Exit is the studio. Mapped the first five standard maps (IGN/fandom order). Not 1:1 car rips — CONTAIN dummy+wagon+grenade cast with kit props.

levels.name: TD1 Original Classic
levels.blurb: Short hill, a wall in the path, then a jump. Does the dummy clear or pancake?

levels.name: TD2 Chicken
levels.blurb: Straight road. Oncoming car. Who swerves — or who wins the smash?

levels.name: TD3 Aiming High
levels.blurb: Dive the underpass while traffic sits overhead. Clear the mouth or eat the span.

levels.name: TD4 Chicken Twist
levels.blurb: Twisting road. Oncoming bus, van, car. Survive the weave or collect them all.

levels.name: TD5 Space Program
levels.blurb: Long steep ramp toward the sky. Make the lip — then the ground collects the score.
